name: Shivaji
historical_biography: Founder of Swarajya. Coronated Chhatrapati in 1674. This scenario uses him as the player commander in an early-consolidation setting.
sources_note: Standard modern histories of the Maratha polity; exact campaign dates in this slice are simplified.

name: Afzal Khan (scenario commander)
historical_biography: Bijapur noble sent against Shivaji; killed at the Pratapgad encounter in 1659. Used here as the opposing commander abstraction for the slice. The battle itself is not fully simulated.
sources_note: The Pratapgad encounter is well attested; troop numbers and motives remain debated.

name: Baji Rao I
historical_biography: Peshwa from 1720. Associated with rapid cavalry campaigns across the Deccan and into northern India. This scenario uses him as the player commander in a simplified expansion setting.
sources_note: Standard modern histories of the Peshwa period; campaign routes and force sizes remain debated.

name: Nizam-ul-Mulk (Asaf Jah I)
historical_biography: Founder of the Asaf Jahi dynasty at Hyderabad. Opposed and negotiated with Maratha expansion in the Deccan. Used here as the principal opposing commander abstraction.
sources_note: Broad outline high confidence; specific engagements in this slice are simplified.

name: Mahadji Scindia
historical_biography: Major Scindia leader in the later eighteenth century. Used here as the player commander in a confederacy abstraction.
sources_note: Broad career is well attested; this scenario does not reconstruct any single campaign.

name: Tukoji Holkar (scenario)
historical_biography: Holkar leadership abstraction for competing-house dynamics. Not a literal portrait of one year.
sources_note: House rivalry is historical; exact pairing is gameplay.

name: Company field force
historical_biography: Abstracted Company field force for late-period pressure. Not a named historical general.
sources_note: Company expansion is historical; this unit is a gameplay stand-in.
